hints: A full turn around the clock face is 360 degrees, split evenly among the 12 numbers.
Multiply the number of marks passed by 30 degrees.

canonical: Each of the 12 numbers on a clock face is 30 degrees apart (360 / 12 = 30).
Turning from 12 to the 1 mark passes 1 of these 30-degree gaps: 30 x 1.

stem: A clock's minute hand starts pointing at the 12 and turns clockwise until it points at the 1 mark. Each number on a clock face is 30 degrees apart from the next around the circle. Through how many degrees has the minute hand turned?
